messages:
maria.rev: FYI — Prospect 'Armadillo Tech' wants to migrate from CompetitorX. They asked for a presales plan: POC, cost mapping (CompetitorX bills by response-bucket), security questionnaire, and how we handle response deltas for their scoring pipeline.
ajay.se: Noted. Do they require a transparent drop-in endpoint?
maria.rev: Yes, they prefer minimal client changes. Ideally a URL-level shim for their existing calls. They also mentioned conversational sessions stored server-side by CompetitorX.
tess.eng: We can deliver a shim. Main risk items: tokenizer-induced token count differences (affects billing), default sampling differences (temperature/top_p), and stop-sequence matching. All can cause scoring drift.
olivia.solutions: Proposed approach: 1) sample their top 200 prompts across NLU, summarization, and classification; 2) run A/B between CompetitorX and Redwood models + 1 quantized config; 3) measure response divergence and scoring impact.
neil.security: Security needs: SCIM for SSO, BYOK KMS, IP allowlist, audit logs export, and contract addendum for data residency. We'll need their legal and compliance contact to sign the BC/DR and SOC pages.
sec-bot: neil.security uploaded their questionnaire response template (link: https://security.redwood.example/armadillo/480987).
ajay.se: Adapter mapping example for common call: CompetitorX payload:
```
POST /api/respond
{
  "prompt": "Classify intent: ...",
  "max_out": 64
}
```
Translate to Redwood SDK call:
```
POST /v1/completions
{
  "model": "redwood-gen-1",
  "input": "Classify intent: ...",
  "max_output_tokens": 64
}
```
Note: we should add normalization for newline-only stops; CompetitorX used literal "\\n\\n".
maria.rev: They also want a billing estimator for their finance team. They currently pay per-response band (S,M,L) and want to see an estimated monthly cost on per-token billing.
olivia.solutions: I'll build a small estimator: take a sample of 500 responses under CompetitorX, calculate average tokens per band, then show projected token spend x per-token price. Also include embedding cost if they use similarity search.
tess.eng: For session handling — Hosted: suggest client includes full convo or passes session-id and we set a temp KV pin for POC. Dedicated/Private: KV pinning available. Also include guidance on memory windows and truncation strategy.
neil.security: For BYOK: we support AWS KMS and GCP KMS for Private deployments; Hosted can leverage customer-managed keys via a dedicated contract. Need to record acceptable cipher suites in SA doc.
ajay.se: Acceptance criteria: (a) parity suite pass rate <=3% major regressions, (b) P95 latency under 700ms at their expected 150 TPS, (c) security questionnaire signed, (d) cost projection within 15% after sampling.
maria.rev: They want a demo in 12 business days.
olivia.solutions: Timeline proposal: day 0-2 onboard creds + security kickoff; day 3-5 deploy adapter + smoke; day 6-9 run parity suite & billing samples; day 10-12 remediation & demo prep.
tess.eng: Engineering caveat: if their scoring uses exact token offsets (char positions), tokenization differences will require an offset-mapping shim — can add heuristics but not perfect. Include examples in the test set.
maria.rev: Great. @neil.security please start the SA doc and loop in their compliance. @ajay.se spin up the proxy repo and post the first smoke logs here.
neil.security: On it. Need their compliance email and sample ACLs.
maria.rev: Sent in DM.
olivia.solutions: I'll post the parity harness link tomorrow. Also will include a Colab notebook for the finance team to play with parameters. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
ajay.se: Initial PR with proxy and smoke logs expected EOD tomorrow.
maria.rev: Thanks team — keeping thread for all POC comms. :thumbsup:
